newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates up after OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates up after OMO.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank overnight funds rose on Saturday after the State (central) Bank of Pakistan mopped up 11 billion rupees in an open market operation (OMO) on Thursday, dealers said.
Initial bids and offers were at 14 percent and 18 percent respectively, but funds started changing hands between 16.5 and 17 percent, one dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank Ltd said.
He said rates went slightly higher near the close of the day.
The market was expected to remain at the same level on Sunday, dealers said.
